{{nihongo|'''Yata ni Imasu Kushitamahiko Shrine'''|矢田坐久志玉比古神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Yata|Q17173675|qid=Q17173675|lt=Yata-chō}}, {{ill|Yamatokōriyama|Q118213|qid=Q118213}}, {{ill|Nara Prefecture|Q131287|qid=Q131287}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} listed as a large shrine, and its former {{ill|Shakaku|Q10444029|qid=Q10444029}} was {{ill|Ken-sha|lt=kensha|qid=Q90139226}}. It is also known as Yaochi Shrine or Yaochi Myōjin<ref name="観光ナビ">[http://yamatokoriyama.locodoco.net/sightseeing/sightseeing-cate03/402.html#firstPage Loco-Doko Tourism Navi: Yata ni Imasu Kushitamahiko Shrine]</ref>. {{nihongo|'''Yata ni Imasu Kushitamahiko Shrine'''|矢田坐久志玉比古神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Yamato Province]].

== Enshrined deities ==
* Principal deities - Kushitamahiko-no-Kami ({{ill|Nigihayahi|fr|Nigihayahi|ja|ニギハヤヒ|simple|Nigihayahi|zh|饒速日命|qid=Q10949054|lt=Kushitama-Nigihayahi-no-Mikoto}}), {{ill|Mikashikiya-hime|Q11341880|qid=Q11341880|lt=Mikashikiyahime-no-Mikoto}}

== History ==
The exact date of the shrine's founding is unknown. According to the '{{ill|Kujiki|Q2716751|qid=Q2716751}},' the enshrined deity {{ill|Nigihayahi|fr|Nigihayahi|ja|ニギハヤヒ|simple|Nigihayahi|zh|饒速日命|qid=Q10949054|lt=Kushitama-Nigihayahi-no-Mikoto}} flew through the sky riding the {{ill|Ama-no-iwafune|Q126914107|qid=Q126914107}} (Heavenly Rock Ship). It is said that the second arrow that Kushitama-Nigihayahi-no-Kami shot from heaven landed at the spot where this shrine was built<ref name="観光ナビ"/>. Furthermore, the area came to be called "Yata" (arrow-field) because of this event.

In the entry for divine estate grants of various shrines dated {{ill|Daidō|de|Daidō (Ära)|es|Daidō|fa|دایدو (دوره)|fr|Ère Daidō|ia|Daido|id|Daidō|ja|大同 (日本)|ko|다이도 (일본)|ru|Дайдо (нэнго)|simple|Daidō|sr|Даидо|th|ไดโด|tr|Daidō|uk|Дайдо|zh|大同 (日本)|zh_yue|大同 (日本)|qid=Q1373191|lt=Daidō}} 1 ({{ill|806|Q30021|qid=Q30021}}) in the '{{ill|Shinshō Kyakuchokufushō|Q11502312|qid=Q11502312}},' it states "Yata Shrine, two households, {{ill|Yamato Province|be|Ямата (правінцыя)|ca|Província de Yamato|ckb|پارێزگای یەماتۆ|cs|Provincie Jamato|de|Provinz Yamato|el|Επαρχία Γιαμάτο|es|Provincia de Yamato|fa|ولایت یاماتو|fi|Yamaton provinssi|fr|Province de Yamato|gl|Provincia de Yamato|hak|Yamato-koet|id|Provinsi Yamato|it|Yamato (provincia)|ja|大和国|ko|야마토국|lt|Jamato žemė|nl|Yamato (provincie)|no|Yamato (provins)|pt|Província de Yamato|ro|Provincia Yamato|ru|Ямато (провинция)|simple|Yamato Province|sk|Jamato (provincia)|sr|Провинција Јамато|th|แคว้นยามาโตะ|tr|Yamato (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Ямато|ur|یاماتو صوبہ|zh|大和國|zh_min_nan|Yamato-kok|zh_yue|大和國|qid=Q907495|lt=Yamato}}," confirming that the shrine is an ancient institution predating that record<ref>Nara Prefecture History reference</ref>. Additionally, {{ill|Emperor Nintoku|Q313119|qid=Q313119}}'s consort {{ill|Princess Yata|Q10892311|qid=Q10892311|lt=Princess Yata}} is thought to have come from this area<ref>From 'Shikinaisha no Kenkyū,' Volume 2</ref>.

The shrine is regarded as the greatest ancient shrine of the region; from its founding through the first half of the 6th century, it is said to have prospered as the foremost celebrated shrine in the entire {{ill|Kinai|Q906708|qid=Q906708}} region<ref name="観光ナビ"/>. It is the head shrine among the ten shrines of {{ill|Yamato Province|be|Ямата (правінцыя)|ca|Província de Yamato|ckb|پارێزگای یەماتۆ|cs|Provincie Jamato|de|Provinz Yamato|el|Επαρχία Γιαμάτο|es|Provincia de Yamato|fa|ولایت یاماتو|fi|Yamaton provinssi|fr|Province de Yamato|gl|Provincia de Yamato|hak|Yamato-koet|id|Provinsi Yamato|it|Yamato (provincia)|ja|大和国|ko|야마토국|lt|Jamato žemė|nl|Yamato (provincie)|no|Yamato (provins)|pt|Província de Yamato|ro|Provincia Yamato|ru|Ямато (провинция)|simple|Yamato Province|sk|Jamato (provincia)|sr|Провинција Јамато|th|แคว้นยามาโตะ|tr|Yamato (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Ямато|ur|یاماتو صوبہ|zh|大和國|zh_min_nan|Yamato-kok|zh_yue|大和國|qid=Q907495}} {{ill|Soejimo district|Q11560415|qid=Q11560415}} listed in the '{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}},' and is an {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}.

In the Shrine Registry of {{ill|1879|Q7783|qid=Q7783}} ({{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}} 12), the shrine's deity was listed as {{ill|Futodama|qid=Q11059539|lt=Ame-no-Futodama-no-Mikoto}}. It appears that the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Meiji government}} applied pressure to have Ame-no-Futodama-no-Mikoto enshrined for approximately 40 years.

In the Meiji era, the shrine was ranked as a gōsha, but in October of {{ill|1938|ab|1938|af|1938|als|1938|am|1938 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1938|ar|1938|ary|1938|arz|1938|ast|1938|av|1938|avk|1938|az|1938|azb|۱۹۳۸ (میلادی)|ba|1938 йыл|ban|1938|bar|1938|bat_smg|1938|bcl|1938|be|1938|be_x_old|1938|bg|1938|bh|1938|bjn|1938|bn|১৯৩৮|bpy|মারি ১৯৩৮|br|1938|bs|1938.|ca|1938|cdo|1938 nièng|ce|1938 шо|ceb|1938|ckb|١٩٣٨|co|1938|crh|1938|cs|1938|csb|1938|cv|1938|cy|1938|da|1938|de|1938|diq|1938|dsb|1938|el|1938|eml|1938|eo|1938|es|1938|et|1938|eu|1938|ext|1938|fa|۱۹۳۸|fi|1938|fiu_vro|1938|fo|1938|fr|1938|frp|1938|frr|1938|fur|1938|fy|1938|ga|1938|gag|1938|gan|1938年|gcr|1938|gd|1938|gl|1938|gn|1938|gv|1938|hak|1938-ngièn|he|1938|hi|१९३८|hif|1938|hr|1938.|hsb|1938|ht|1938 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1938|hy|1938|hyw|1938 թուական|ia|1938|id|1938|ilo|1938|inh|1938 шу|io|1938|is|1938|it|1938|ja|1938年|jv|1938|ka|1938|kaa|1938|kbp|1938|kk|1938 жыл|kn|೧೯೩೮|ko|1938년|krc|1938 джыл|ksh|Joohr 1938|ku|1938|kv|1938-ӧд во|kw|1938|la|1938|lb|1938|lez|1938 йис|li|1938|lij|1938|lmo|1938|ln|1938|lt|1938 m.|lv|1938. gads|mai|१९३८|map_bms|1938|mdf|1938|mg|1938|mhr|1938|mi|1938|min|1938|mk|1938|ml|1938|mn|1938 он|mr|इ.स. १९३८|mrj|1938 и|ms|1938|my|၁၉၃၈|myv|1938 ие|mzn|۱۹۳۸|nah|1938|nap|1938|nds|1938|nds_nl|1938|new|ई सं १९३८|nl|1938|nn|1938|no|1938|nov|1938|nrm|1938|nso|1938|oc|1938|olo|1938|or|୧୯୩୮|os|1938-æм аз|pa|1938|pam|1938|pap|1938|pl|1938|pnb|1938|pt|1938|qu|1938|rm|1938|ro|1938|roa_rup|1938|roa_tara|1938|ru|1938 год|rue|1938|sah|1938|sc|1938|scn|1938|sco|1938|sd|1938ع|se|1938|sh|1938.|shn|1938|simple|1938|sk|1938|sl|1938|smn|1938|sq|1938|sr|1938|stq|1938|su|1938|sv|1938|sw|1938|szl|1938|ta|1938|te|1938|tg|Соли 1938|th|พ.ศ. 2481|tk|1938|tl|1938|tly|1938|tpi|1938|tr|1938|tt|1938 ел|ty|1938|udm|1938 ар|ug|1938 - يىلى|uk|1938|ur|1938ء|uz|1938|vec|1938|vi|1938|vls|1938|vo|1938|wa|1938|war|1938|wuu|1938年|xmf|1938|yi|1938|za|1938 nienz|zea|1938|zh|1938年|zh_classical|一九三八年|zh_min_nan|1938 nî|zh_yue|1938年|qid=Q18645}} ({{ill|Shōwa era|Q327567|qid=Q327567}} 13), it was elevated to {{ill|Ken-sha|lt=kensha|qid=Q90139226}}.

Because of the tradition that Kushitama-Nigihayahi-no-Mikoto flew through the sky on the Ama-no-Iwafune, Kushitama-Nigihayahi-no-Mikoto is revered as the ancestral deity of aviation, and an Aviation Festival is held every year on September 20<ref name="観光案内">[https://www.yk-kankou.jp/spotDetail24.html Yamatokōriyama City Tourism Association: Yata ni Imasu Kushitamahiko Shrine]</ref>. In the upper story of the gate tower, a {{ill|Propeller (aeronautics)|Q922654|qid=Q922654}} said to have been used on a {{ill|Fighter aircraft|Q127771|qid=Q127771}} has been dedicated and placed on display<ref name="観光ナビ"/>.

Within the precinct there is a Ni-no-ya-zuka (Second Arrow Mound)<ref name="観光ナビ"/>. There is also a theory that this very area is the site of {{ill|Yamatai|Q844295|qid=Q844295}}<ref name="観光案内"/>.

== Precinct ==
* Honden ({{ill|Important Cultural Property (Japan)|de|Wichtiges Kulturgut Japans|es|Bien Cultural Importante de Japón|fi|Japanin tärkeä kulttuuriomaisuus|fr|Bien culturel important|id|Properti Kebudayaan Penting (Jepang)|it|Bene culturale importante (Giappone)|ja|重要文化財|ko|일본의 중요문화재|ro|Patrimoniu cultural important al Japoniei|simple|Important Cultural Properties of Japan|th|ทรัพย์สินทางวัฒนธรรมที่สำคัญ (ญี่ปุ่น)|tr|Önemli Kültürel Varlık (Japonya)|uk|Важливі культурні пам'ятки Японії|zh|重要文化財|qid=Q1188622}}) - Rebuilt in the early {{ill|Muromachi period|Q334845|qid=Q334845}}. One-bay {{ill|Kasuga-zukuri|es|Kasuga-zukuri|fr|Kasuga-zukuri|ja|春日造|ru|Касуга-дзукури|qid=Q3193781}}, cypress-bark roofing<ref name="文化財">[https://www.city.yamatokoriyama.lg.jp/soshiki/machidukuri_senryaku/rekishi_bunkazai/bunkazai101/j_bunkazai/kenzobutsu/1869.html Yamatokōriyama City Cultural Properties: Yata ni Imasu Kushitamahiko Shrine]</ref>.
* Shinmon (sacred gate)
* Haiden

* Shamusho (shrine office)

== Auxiliary shrines ==
* {{ill|Hachiman shrine|lt=Hachiman Shrine|qid=Q11390939}} (Important Cultural Property) - Deity: {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Homudawake-no-Mikoto}}. Rebuilt in the mid-Muromachi period<ref name="文化財"/>.
* {{ill|Wakamiya Shrine|Q11616280|qid=Q11616280}} - Deities: {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Umashimaji-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|Amaterasu|abstract|Q455602|ar|أماتيراسو|ary|أماطيراسو|az|Amaterasu|bcl|Amaterasu|be|Аматэрасу|be_x_old|Аматэрасу|bew|Amatérasu|bg|Аматерасу|ca|Amaterasu|cs|Amaterasu|da|Amaterasu|de|Amaterasu|el|Αματεράσου|eo|Amaterasu|es|Amaterasu|et|Amaterasu|eu|Amaterasu|fa|آماتراسو|fi|Amaterasu|fr|Amaterasu|gl|Amaterasu|he|אמטראסו|hi|अमातेरसु|hr|Amaterasu|hu|Amateraszu Ómikami|hy|Ամատերասու Օմիկամի|id|Amaterasu|it|Amaterasu|ja|天照大神|jv|Amaterasu|ka|ამატერასუ|ko|아마테라스 오미카미|la|Amaterasu|lb|Amaterasu|lt|Amaterasu|lv|Amaterasu|min|Amaterasu|ml|അമതേരസു|mni|ꯑꯃꯇꯦꯔꯁꯨ ꯑꯣꯃꯤꯀꯃꯤ|ms|Amaterasu|nl|Amaterasu|nn|Amaterasu|no|Amaterasu|or|ଆମାତେରାଶୁ|pa|ਆਮਾਤੇਰਸ|pl|Amaterasu|pt|Amaterasu|ro|Amaterasu|rsk|Аматерасу|ru|Аматэрасу|sco|Amaterasu|sh|Amaterasu|simple|Amaterasu Ōmikami|sk|Amaterasu Ómikami|sl|Amaterasu|sr|Аматерасу|su|Amaterasu|sv|Amaterasu|ta|அமதெரசு|th|อามาเตราซุ|tl|Amaterasu|tok|jan sewi suli Amatelasu|tr|Amaterasu|uk|Аматерасу|uz|Amaterasu|vi|Amaterasu|wuu|天照大神|zh|天照大神|zh_min_nan|Amaterasu|zh_yue|天照大神|qid=Q455602|lt=Amaterasu Ōmikami}}, {{ill|Mizuhanome|lt=Mizuhanome-no-Kami|qid=Q8191796}}
* Outlying shrines
** Nushito Shrine - Deities: {{ill|Nigihayahi|fr|Nigihayahi|ja|ニギハヤヒ|simple|Nigihayahi|zh|饒速日命|qid=Q10949054|lt=Nigihayahi-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|Mikashikiya-hime|Q11341880|qid=Q11341880|lt=Mikashikiyahime-no-Mikoto}}. Alternatively, one theory holds the deities are Mikashikiyahime-no-Mikoto and {{ill|Ame no Hiratome|Q85879124|qid=Q85879124}} (あめのひりとめのみこと), but it appears that Ame-no-Hiritome-no-Mikoto was only temporarily enshrined due to Meiji government pressure. Being both an outlying shrine and an {{ill|Otabisho|Q11489117|qid=Q11489117}} (sacred resting place for the portable shrine), considering its role as otabisho, the deities appear to be the two kami Nigihayahi-no-Mikoto and Mikashikiyahime-no-Mikoto<ref>Confirmed with the chief priest</ref>.
** {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Yasaka Shrine}}: Deity: {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Susanoo}}. Currently independent.
